content: {"summary":"During the May 2026 checkout incident a single checkout could expand to up to nine processor attempts, and the incident stopped after the CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS setting was reduced to 1.","likely_cause":"Retry multiplier caused multiple nested attempts (up to nine) per checkout, overwhelming the card processor and triggering edge 504s.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"One checkout can fan out into up to nine attempts against the processor","evidence_ids":["RB-016#0"],"quote":"That's up to nine attempts against the processor for one button press."},{"text":"Setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 stopped the incident","evidence_ids":["RB-016#5"],"quote":"It ended within minutes of setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1."}],"next_checks":["Verify the CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS value was applied to payments‑api ConfigMap during the incident","Check logs for the exact number of attempts per checkout request","Confirm edge‑gateway timeout remained unchanged while the setting was applied"]}
